_purpose: When a pipeline fails, validate the failure and trigger remediation
_pattern: Event-based rule that mediates between CodePipeline and PipelineValidator concept

when.description: Triggers when CodePipeline execution state changes

then.description: Invoke PipelineValidator concept to analyze failure

operational_principle.description: After pipeline fails -> validator analyzes -> result logged -> remediation triggered if needed
operational_principle.example: Pipeline 'my-app' fails -> PipelineValidator checks logs -> determines cause -> returns structured result
